thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P12345 triggered — control-plane deps: auth + org-lookup are returning 502/504s across gateway. Error rate spiked to ~15% in us-east-1. Auto-escalation to oncall-sre.

alex_k: seeing the same in dashboard — controlplane -> auth -> orglookup chain shows increased latency then 5xx. Timeouts from orglookup calls are at ~1200ms.

maria_c: customer reports: some tenants seeing 5xx when creating sessions. CS reported two enterprise customers paging.

jay_p: I'm on it. first step: reroute traffic away from the failing auth variant and enable the fallback org-cache.

oncall-sre: taking pager. handoff at 2134567920. pinging infra now for quick mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident channel created automatically: #incidents/P12345. Initial impact: 12% global 5xx for control-plane requests, peak 18% in us-east-1. Affected endpoints: /v1/auth/*, /v1/orgs/lookup.

alex_k: quick telemetry: auth pod logs show upstream 502 from org-lookup: "upstream response timeout" and repeated `ECONNRESET`.

maria_c: tagging product and support: @cust-success-bot can you start an incident email? include note: "intermittent 502s for session creation and org lookups; mitigation in progress"

cust-success-bot: Drafting notice now. ETA 3m.

jay_p: attempting to enable cached-org-lookup TTL fallback (reads only) via feature-flag. Command:

```
kubectl -n controlplane set env deployment/auth-service ENABLE_ORG_CACHE_FALLBACK=true
kubectl -n controlplane patch deployment orglookup --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"orglookup","env":[{"name":"ORG_CACHE_TTL_MS","value":"300000"}]}]}}}}'
```

alex_k: also increasing gateway downstream timeout to 5s as a temporary measure. config push started.

eng-platform: pushing a routing rule to send 20% traffic to standby auth cluster in us-west-2 as a canary reroute.

incident-bot: Update: feature-flag applied, orglookup fallback will serve cached responses for keys present. Monitoring for increased error reduction.

natalie_r: logs from orglookup show a surge of heavy batched queries from a downstream analytics flow starting ~2134567800 — looks correlated. Query per-second jumped 6x.

jay_p: can we throttle the analytics job at the source? adding a rate-limit config to the gateway: `ratelimit: 200r/s per service` for the analytics route.

eng-platform: applied rate-limit via envoy config; drop to 10% error rate seen so far. Gateway reports connection resets decreased.

oncall-sre: quick customer-impact summary: ~10% of API calls returned 5xx during the spike window. Major customers affected: corpA and corpB (partial). No data loss reported, some request retries succeeded.

alex_k: temp mitigation checklist: 1) org cache fallback enabled; 2) throttle analytics; 3) route 20% to standby; 4) increase timeouts. All in progress.

maria_c: thanks — continuing to monitor. I'll coordinate with CS on messaging once we have sustained <1% errors for 15m.

incident-bot: Automated update: KPIs now: 5xx rate down to 3% (rolling 5m), p95 latency for auth reduced from 2.2s -> 0.6s.

jay_p: running a quick heap/profile check on orglookup pods to rule out GC/oom. output snippet:

```
orglookup-0 logs:
[WARN] slow-query 1201ms key=acct-123
[INFO] cache-hit 0.34
[ERROR] upstream timeout after 1000ms
```

natalie_r: looks like cache-hit ratio was low — warming the cache could help. I started a controlled cache-warm job for top 10k org ids.

eng-platform: we saw a config deploy on orglookup 17m before the spike. rolling back that deploy now to see if performance regresses.

oncall-sre: rollback initiated. if rollback recovers, follow-up to postmortem: revert/change in that release.

incident-bot: Pager update: P12345 -> acknowledged, mitigations applied. Current status: under investigation.

alex_k: monitoring shows rollback + throttles + cache fallback -> error rates holding at ~0.8% across regions for 7m. continuing watch.

maria_c: handoff scheduled in 45m to daytime oncall. adding action items: postmortem owner (jay_p), customer follow-up (natalie_r), rollback analysis (eng-platform).

cust-success-bot: Sent interim customer note to affected accounts with summary and ETA for resolution.

oncall-sre: concluding active mitigation. leaving watch mode to oncall-sre-backfill at 2134568345. Please escalate if we see >2% error again.

jay_p: quick runbook notes to capture: root suspects = config deploy + sudden analytics QPS spike -> overload orglookup -> upstream timeouts -> gateway 502s. Mitigations used: cache fallback, throttle, routing, rollback.

maria_c: thanks team. filing incident ticket P12345 with summary and first-draft timeline. will link logs and prod traces.

incident-bot: Incident P12345 auto-closed for active paging at 2134567945 (mitigations stable). Please ensure postmortem created within 48h.
